name: Supplier quote request writer
why: Writes a quote request in maker terms, the same job as the sourcing plan and RFQ skill for product brands.

name: Supplier quote comparer
why: Puts supplier quotes side by side on price, minimums, lead time and cash needed, as in quote levelling.

name: Supplier shortlist vetter
why: Scores a factory shortlist and its red flags before a deposit, alongside the due diligence skill.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: Works out landed cost per unit from a quote, freight and duty, the cost step in quote levelling.

name: Factory price-break negotiator
why: Plans a factory price talk with asks, give-backs and a fallback, matching the negotiation skill.

name: Negotiation call prep planner
why: Prepares the opening, questions and listening points for a hard supplier call.

name: Monthly contract renewal keeper
why: Keeps renewal and notice dates, price rises and asks in view every month, so nothing rolls over unnoticed.

name: Prepare a contract renewal negotiation
why: A renewal negotiation pack, the same moment as the renewal brief in the negotiation skill.

name: Find duplicate and unused business subscriptions
why: Finds duplicate and unused subscriptions, the first pass of the spend and subscription review.

name: Code vendor bills, flag odd ones and find supplier savings
why: Codes supplier bills, flags odd ones and finds savings, as in the quarterly spend review.

name: Preserve a procurement decision audit trail
why: Keeps the record of how a supplier was chosen, the file step at the end of every award.

name: Procurement evidence gap review assistant
why: Checks vendor proposals against an approval checklist and lists the proof still missing.

name: Supplier terms and float planner
why: Works out the payment terms to ask for from the order cycle and cash, a common trade in negotiations.

name: Plan a vendor change without losing work
why: Plans the switch after a new supplier is chosen, including data and exit steps from the contract check.
